title: UH Faculty Feature Highlights Design for Aging
summary: A University of Houston faculty feature introduces Park's approach to inclusive technology and participatory design.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: Chorong Park shared a University of Houston faculty feature on October 28, 2025, drawing attention to her work at the intersection of design, aging, and interactive technology.

Published in September, the college's announcement introduced three faculty members bringing expertise in preservation, urban planning, and user experience. Its profile of Park describes research spanning aging, disability studies, and human-computer interaction, including immersive experiences and social robots.

The feature places participation at the heart of Park's approach: developing technology with attention to the people who will use it. The original university article offers further background on her research and design practice.
